sources.title: Lithium polymer batteries
sources.locator_notes: Direct HTTPS HTML: each exact Type row, unqualified capacity and T/W/L envelope; Technical info describes soft/pouch cells. Each row links the selected PDF. Page capacities equal the selected PDF Minimum values. No claim that these editions are globally latest.

sources.title: Product Safety Data Sheet - Lithium Ion (Polymer) Rechargeable Battery
sources.locator_notes: Direct HTTPS PDF read in memory. Page 1 Section I names the manufacturer; page 8 prints the edition date; page 9 annex names these six models. LP851719JU is not in this annex and is not assigned this source. The annex labels capacity Minimum; these six rows agree with selected individual PDFs.

sources.locator_notes: Opened official PDF by direct HTTPS and in-memory text extraction.
